items.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
items.summary: The company said the accounting correction will cut reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 after bitcoin held on Biconomy could not be withdrawn.

items.title: Moody’s Assigns Ripple’s RLUSD A2 and P-1 Deposit Ratings
items.summary: The ratings cover native RLUSD on XRP Ledger and Ethereum, with reserve safeguards weighed against holders’ exposure to an issuer bankruptcy.

items.title: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’
items.summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption to flourish in the US.

items.title: Datavault AI stock plummets 50% after firm says it cannot withdraw bitcoin tied to $150 million deal
items.summary: The issue centers on a deal with Scilex, under which Scilex agreed to buy shares of Datavault AI for $150 million, payable in bitcoin.
